as_told.title: RAND Corporation, Project Orion and Townsend Brown's 1967 demo

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, a researcher working on anti-gravity, showed his experiments to the RAND Corporation, a research group that advises the US military, and after that meeting his work went dark, Michels says; in one telling it was quietly handed to the aircraft maker Northrop Grumman for the B-2 stealth bomber. Michels tells it in three episodes and the dates shift: once in the 1960s, once in the 1950s, and once as a demo in 1967. If true, it would mean a promising gravity technology was taken out of public view and put into secret military aircraft.
